kultivator.guide.chapter.17.desc: Raise your mountain above the clouds: two paths, the Ascension, the cloud net, the ferry, cloud pirates and the other sky palaces.
kultivator.guide.c17.syarat.title: Prepare the hall for the sky
kultivator.guide.c17.syarat.body:
In ancient times five mountains floated above Guixu, carried by the turtles of heaven. A strong enough sect can raise its own mountain above the clouds.
Path A (Raise the Mountain): hall level 6 or a tier-6 site, an active Grand Formation, the Golden Core realm for A1-A3 (Nascent Soul A4-A6, Deity Transformation A7-A8, Dao Union A9).
Path B (Found Above the Clouds): a new hall without a template may pick A1-A3 straight away.
Command: /kultivasi aula langit.
kultivator.guide.c17.rancang.title: Design the sky island
kultivator.guide.c17.rancang.body:
On the Build page pick the Cloud tab: template A1-A9, plaza height (steps of 4, usually y 232), shift and rotation.
The sky validator checks the space above the site: no tall trees, mountains or buildings inside the island space.
The Mountain-Raising Offering is taken from your bag on confirmation (spirit stones, phantom membranes, ender pearls) and returned if you cancel before the first block.
kultivator.guide.c17.tapak.title: Build the Cloud Core
kultivator.guide.c17.tapak.body:
Tier 1 is built from the material store like a ground site, while the stele still stands on the ground (tethered). A pillar of light joins the stele and the Cloud Throne.
Tiers 2-9 start only after the Ascension.
kultivator.guide.c17.naik.title: The Ascension
kultivator.guide.c17.naik.body:
Lift the stele on the ground, fly it up (sword, ship, ferry) and set it on the jade plinth of the Cloud Throne. Choose the ground site's fate: keep it as the Mountain Foot, take it down, or leave it.
Your disciples arrive in puffs of cloud; the hall level is guaranteed for 30 days until the island catches up with the ground tier.
The ground Grand Formation does not come along: the hall's ward returns when sky tier 5 is done.
kultivator.guide.c17.formasi.title: The Cloud Transfer formation
kultivator.guide.c17.formasi.body: The sky node comes with tier 1; you build the ground node yourself within 128 blocks of the stele (a quartz ring, amethyst corners, a formation eye). One trip: 1 Daya and 10 Qi, up to 4 disciples come along.
kultivator.guide.c17.tangga.title: The Cloud Stair
kultivator.guide.c17.tangga.body:
Tier 3 builds a spiral stair from the ground into the island's belly, with a rest landing every 24 blocks. Candidates arrive at its foot on Recruitment Day and climb it themselves.
Walk all the way up without flying: the advancement A Thousand Steps.
kultivator.guide.c17.jaring.title: The Cloud Net and the Cloud Dive
kultivator.guide.c17.jaring.body:
No member dies falling off their own island: the Cloud Net slows, then catches you and returns you to your last safe spot.
With the Cloud Net formation (tier 5), hold Shift as you leave the edge: you glide down to the ground unhurt.
Raiders and cloud pirates are not protected.
kultivator.guide.c17.feri.title: The Cloud Ferry
kultivator.guide.c17.feri.body: Tier 7 builds the ferry stop. Ring the bell at a stop or type /kultivasi langit feri: a cloud boat comes to your side and carries members and disciples up or down.
kultivator.guide.c17.bajak.title: Cloud Pirates
kultivator.guide.c17.bajak.body:
From tier 3, cloud pirates now and then break through the sea of clouds and come alongside the docks. Drive them off: renown and a chest of spoils into the Lumbung. If nobody fights them for 10 minutes, they take part of the material store.
On A7+ islands at tier 8 the Giant of Longbo sometimes comes too, to steal the island's carrier turtle.
kultivator.guide.c17.temu.title: Palaces above the clouds
kultivator.guide.c17.temu.body: Some of the strongest NPC sects also own a Cloud Palace floating above their mountain gate (new chunks only). Visit it: their stance decides the welcome. Allies grant a mooring right and visit with sky herbs.
kultivator.guide.c17.sembilan.title: Palace of the Nine Heavens
kultivator.guide.c17.sembilan.body:
Tier 9 adds the Gate of the Nine Heavens, the hanging crystals and the isle of Daiyu. At dusk the Heaven Court's envoy may descend with the Heaven Court's Order: accept, decline with respect, or Challenge Heaven.
The waterfalls at the island's edge are only mist; no water ever falls from your sect's sky.
kultivator.screen.help.sekte_langit:
A sect above the clouds: a floating island built from the material store (the Cloud template family A1-A9), the stele carried up to the Cloud Throne (the Ascension).
Qi at height: members on the island get the Sky Sect site ×1.05-1.25 (inside meditation's ×3.5 cap) and a thriftier vein (×0.85-0.9).
Weather immunity: snow and rain never touch the island; lightning above it is only light.
Events: cloud pirates, the Giant of Longbo, the Heaven Court envoy, sky sect guests, the Lantern Festival.
No block changes except through the sect build engine; NPC sky palaces are born only in new chunks.
Screen: Hub › Sect › School › Sky Sect, or /kultivasi langit.
